title: A queue question can be answered by an agent, marked so
what: A decision an agent makes is recorded with the same question, options and answer notes the owner's questions use, plus a mark of who answered (the owner, or which agent, with the deciding session's id so one can tell which session it was), so one can later find who took each decision and the owner can reverse it.
why: 30 Oct: front decisions are written as fact notes ("fact (front)", text "front decision (owner can reverse)"); the queue has no decision record, some decisions lived only in session briefs, and nothing lists who decided what. The owner chose that review questions a principle answers are decided by the reviewer (work-goes-on-while-the-owner-is-away). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).

said: Да, отправь тип записи «решение» на проектирование, изначально я подразумевал ту же самую структуру с вопросом, вариантами ответа и выбором + поле для пометки (ответил AI), это звучит просто как доработка текущего функционала, чтобы после можно было вернуться и установить - кто принял то или иное решение

fact: 30 Oct, front decision (owner can reverse; principle 1 cheap before expensive, principle 8 the owner reads): build the reviewed design (revision 2) in two steps: first only the record (question, options, "decided by front", chosen letter, reason; the owner's answer may carry a letter; "waiting for the owner" split into two rules; metrics do not count a reversal as owner waiting), about 65 agent minutes; the list of all decisions and the guard-hook check become separate queue items. Each wave digest gets one line per decision taken without the owner (about 7 a day). Reviewer decisions stay in check records in git (108 of 363 records have no queue item), reversible with relay check owner.
